versions.content: AUTOSAR libraries shall use C interfaces Type: Valid Description: Library functionality shall be accessible via C interfaces with prototypes provided in standard header files. This also includes pu blication of library specifics types. Accordingly a library can only access other library functionality Rationale: Usage of libraries is based on an implementor’s design decision and therefore cannot be under control of system configuration. Hence, mechan isms like RTE or services from Basic Software Modules are not available Use Case: Making library code accessible for BSW and SW - C Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: --
